verdict.rationale: Copilot provides code review with inline suggested changes and severity-labeled comments (docs-28, docs-29), integrated with PR diffs, plus Autofix for vulnerability detection (docs-13) and agent mode validation of files (docs-22). This directly supports inspecting diffs and catching problems pre-merge. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the code-review feature's real-world accuracy and no explicit mention of running CI/test checks as part of the flow.
